horizon_semantics: Each D means the N-th subsequent observation/trading session in this daily market dataset, not N calendar days. This avoids fabricating values on weekends/holidays.

model_ready_common_dataset.reason: Last 30 observations cannot have a verified 30-session future target.

leakage_controls: Original feature columns were preserved exactly.
Target values are generated only from Close at row i+h.
Target dates are stored explicitly for auditability.
No interpolation or synthetic future prices were created.
Rows without real future observations remain blank in the full labeled dataset.
The common model-ready dataset keeps only rows with all six real targets.
